<reason>PRO kept a live route that CON never neutralized: mobile populations plus ghost-leakage require interoperable verification, and fragmentation already surveils without remedy. CON's strongest hits on coerced consent and unenforceable purpose limits land, but its alternative of accept-what-she-carries never explains trust/fraud across borders, leaving PRO's feed-first weighing of certain exclusion vs containable logged risk as the cleaner vote under the motion.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B's Q1 on how mutual recognition pays a migrant/verifies vaccines without any check, and A's thin answer of clearing funds plus reading a hand-held document, exposed that CON's no-lookup alternative cannot solve the leakage/mobility problem PRO built its case on.</best_rebuttal>
